counterfactual_missing_items: specific mention of Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris characteristics beyond erythematous plaques
distinctive features of alopecia beyond hair loss and brittleness
decisive_items: widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
response.rationale: R1 is the strongest candidate due to the direct mention of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis in the skin biopsy results, which is a characteristic feature of psoriasis. R2, while sharing some similar symptoms, lacks specific distinctive features of Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris beyond the shared symptoms with psoriasis.

rejected.why: R4 focuses on hair loss and brittle hair, which, although present, are not the primary symptoms described in the vignette.
C1 is an append-only completion of R1, providing additional detail but not standing as a distinct diagnosis on its own.
